# Bills

Part of the **Accounts** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List bills

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/bills`

Retrieve a paginated list of vendor bills with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: partner, currency, journal, company, invoicePaymentTerm, fiscalPosition, invoiceUser, partnerShipping, partnerBank, invoiceIncoterm, invoiceCashRounding, paymentMethodLine, campaign, source, medium, creator, invoiceLines, invoiceLines.product, invoiceLines.uom, invoiceLines.taxes, invoiceLines.account, invoiceLines.currency, invoiceLines.companyCurrency, invoiceLines.partner, invoiceLines.creator, invoiceLines.journal, invoiceLines.company, invoiceLines.groupTax, invoiceLines.taxGroup, invoiceLines.payment, invoiceLines.taxRepartitionLine | `partner,invoiceLines.product` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by bill number (partial match) |  |
| `filter[partner_id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of partner IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[state]` | string | No | Filter by state (draft, posted, cancel) |  |
| `filter[payment_state]` | string | No | Filter by payment state |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `invoice_date` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/bills?include=partner%2CinvoiceLines.product&sort=invoice_date&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/bills?include=partner%2CinvoiceLines.product&sort=invoice_date&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/bills?include=partner%2CinvoiceLines.product&sort=invoice_date&page=1', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/bills?include=partner%2CinvoiceLines.product&sort=invoice_date&page=1"

    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

## Create bill

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/bills`

Create a new vendor bill

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `partner_id` | integer | Yes | The vendor/partner ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `currency_id` | integer | Yes | The currency ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `journal_id` | integer | Yes | The journal ID for bills. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_date` | string | Yes | The invoice date. Must be a valid date. |
| `invoice_date_due` | string | No | The invoice due date. Cannot be provided if invoice_payment_term_id is specified. Must be a valid date. |
| `invoice_payment_term_id` | integer | No | The payment term ID. Cannot be provided if invoice_date_due is specified. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `fiscal_position_id` | integer | No | The fiscal position ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_user_id` | integer | No | The salesperson/user ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `partner_bank_id` | integer | No | The recipient bank account ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_incoterm_id` | integer | No | The incoterm ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_cash_rounding_id` | integer | No | The cash rounding ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `preferred_payment_method_line_id` | integer | No | The preferred payment method line ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `reference` | string | No | The vendor bill reference. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `payment_reference` | string | No | The payment reference. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `narration` | string | No | Terms and conditions / Internal notes. |
| `incoterm_location` | string | No | The incoterm location. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `delivery_date` | string | No | The delivery date. Must be a valid date. |
| `invoice_lines` | object[] | Yes | Array of invoice line items with product details, quantities, prices, and taxes. Must have at least 1 items. |
| `date` | string | No | The accounting date. Must be a valid date. |
| `invoice_lines[].product_id` | integer | Yes | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_lines[].quantity` | number | Yes | Must be at least 0.0001. |
| `invoice_lines[].uom_id` | integer | Yes | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_lines[].price_unit` | number | Yes |  |
| `invoice_lines[].discount` | number | No | Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 100. |
| `invoice_lines[].taxes` | integer[] | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_lines[].id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/bills" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "partner_id": 1,
  "currency_id": 1,
  "journal_id": 1,
  "invoice_date": "2026-02-16",
  "invoice_date_due": "2026-03-16",
  "invoice_payment_term_id": 1,
  "fiscal_position_id": 1,
  "invoice_user_id": 1,
  "partner_bank_id": 1,
  "invoice_incoterm_id": 1,
  "invoice_cash_rounding_id": 1,
  "preferred_payment_method_line_id": 1,
  "reference": "INV-2026-001",
  "payment_reference": "PAY-001",
  "narration": "Additional information",
  "incoterm_location": "New York",
  "delivery_date": "2026-02-20",
  "invoice_lines": [
    {
      "product_id": 1,
      "quantity": 2,
      "uom_id": 1,
      "price_unit": 100,
      "discount": 10,
      "taxes": [
        1,
        2
      ]
    }
  ],
  "date": "2026-02-17"
}'
```

## Show bill

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/bills/{id}`

Retrieve a specific bill by its ID

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The bill ID |


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: partner, currency, journal, company, invoicePaymentTerm, fiscalPosition, invoiceUser, partnerShipping, partnerBank, invoiceIncoterm, invoiceCashRounding, paymentMethodLine, campaign, source, medium, creator, invoiceLines, invoiceLines.product, invoiceLines.uom, invoiceLines.taxes, invoiceLines.account, invoiceLines.currency, invoiceLines.companyCurrency, invoiceLines.partner, invoiceLines.creator, invoiceLines.journal, invoiceLines.company, invoiceLines.groupTax, invoiceLines.taxGroup, invoiceLines.payment, invoiceLines.taxRepartitionLine | `partner,invoiceLines` |



::: code-group

## Update bill

<Badge type="tip" text="PUT" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/bills/{id}`

Update an existing bill

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The bill ID |



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `partner_id` | integer | No | The vendor/partner ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `currency_id` | integer | No | The currency ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `journal_id` | integer | No | The journal ID for bills. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_date` | string | No | The invoice date. Must be a valid date. |
| `invoice_date_due` | string | No | The invoice due date. Cannot be provided if invoice_payment_term_id is specified. Must be a valid date. |
| `invoice_payment_term_id` | integer | No | The payment term ID. Cannot be provided if invoice_date_due is specified. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `fiscal_position_id` | integer | No | The fiscal position ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_user_id` | integer | No | The salesperson/user ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `partner_bank_id` | integer | No | The recipient bank account ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_incoterm_id` | integer | No | The incoterm ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_cash_rounding_id` | integer | No | The cash rounding ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `preferred_payment_method_line_id` | integer | No | The preferred payment method line ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `reference` | string | No | The vendor bill reference. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `payment_reference` | string | No | The payment reference. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `narration` | string | No | Terms and conditions / Internal notes. |
| `incoterm_location` | string | No | The incoterm location. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `delivery_date` | string | No | The delivery date. Must be a valid date. |
| `invoice_lines` | object[] | No | Array of invoice line items with product details, quantities, prices, and taxes. Must have at least 1 items. |
| `date` | string | No | The accounting date. Must be a valid date. |
| `invoice_lines[].product_id` | integer | Yes | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_lines[].quantity` | number | Yes | Must be at least 0.0001. |
| `invoice_lines[].uom_id` | integer | Yes | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_lines[].price_unit` | number | Yes |  |
| `invoice_lines[].discount` | number | No | Must be at least 0. Must not be greater than 100. |
| `invoice_lines[].taxes` | integer[] | No | Must match an existing stored value. |
| `invoice_lines[].id` | integer | No | Must match an existing stored value. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X PUT "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/bills/{id}" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "partner_id": 1,
  "currency_id": 1,
  "journal_id": 1,
  "invoice_date": "2026-02-16",
  "invoice_date_due": "2026-03-16",
  "invoice_payment_term_id": 1,
  "fiscal_position_id": 1,
  "invoice_user_id": 1,
  "partner_bank_id": 1,
  "invoice_incoterm_id": 1,
  "invoice_cash_rounding_id": 1,
  "preferred_payment_method_line_id": 1,
  "reference": "INV-2026-001",
  "payment_reference": "PAY-001",
  "narration": "Additional information",
  "incoterm_location": "New York",
  "delivery_date": "2026-02-20",
  "invoice_lines": [
    {
      "product_id": 1,
      "quantity": 2,
      "uom_id": 1,
      "price_unit": 100,
      "discount": 10,
      "taxes": [
        1,
        2
      ]
    }
  ],
  "date": "2026-02-17"
}'
```

## Pay bill

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/bills/{id}/pay`

Register payment for a posted bill

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.

**Path parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `id` | integer | Yes | The bill ID |



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `journal_id` | integer | No | Payment journal ID. If omitted, the first available journal is used. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `payment_method_line_id` | integer | No | Payment method line ID for selected journal. If omitted, default method is auto-detected. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `partner_bank_id` | integer | No | Partner bank account ID when required by payment method. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `currency_id` | integer | No | Payment currency ID. If omitted, journal currency or document currency is used. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `payment_date` | string | No | Payment date. Must be a valid date. |
| `communication` | string | No | Payment reference/communication. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `installments_mode` | string | No | Installment mode. |
| `amount` | number | No | Payment amount. Must be at least 0.0001. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/bills/{id}/pay" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "journal_id": 1,
  "payment_method_line_id": 1,
  "partner_bank_id": 3,
  "currency_id": 1,
  "payment_date": "2026-02-17",
  "communication": "INV/2026/0001",
  "installments_mode": "full",
  "amount": 250.75
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/bills/{id}/pay", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "journal_id": 1,
  "payment_method_line_id": 1,
  "partner_bank_id": 3,
  "currency_id": 1,
  "payment_date": "2026-02-17",
  "communication": "INV/2026/0001",
  "installments_mode": "full",
  "amount": 250.75
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]

    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],

    'currency_id' => 1,
    'payment_date' => '2026-02-17',
    'communication' => 'INV/2026/0001',
    'installments_mode' => 'full',
    'amount' => 250.75,
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]

    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

    "currency_id": 1,
    "payment_date": "2026-02-17",

    "installments_mode": "full",

}

data = response.json()
print(data)
```

## Reverse bill
